gloss: to look back; to reflect on

definitions.gloss: to look back; to turn around
definitions.explanation: To physically turn one's head or body to look behind.

definitions.gloss: to reflect on; to look back on
definitions.explanation: To think about or review past events, experiences, or one's own actions.

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ばれて{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}った。
examples.english: I turned around when my name was called.

examples.japanese: {一年|いちねん}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}ると、いろいろなことがあった。
examples.english: Looking back on the year, a lot happened.

examples.japanese: {過去|かこ}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}っても{仕方|しかた}がない。
examples.english: There's no point in dwelling on the past.

notes:
{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}) formed from {振|ふ}る (to swing) + {返|かえ}る (to return). It means to turn back physically or mentally.

ASPECT (ている):
{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}っている indicates the action of looking back is ongoing.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- {振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (physical) — to turn around
- [period/event]を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (figurative) — to reflect on [period/event]

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {過去|かこ}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (look back on the past)
- {人生|じんせい}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (reflect on one's life)
- {一年|いちねん}を{振|ふ}り{返|かえ}る (look back on the year)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {振|ふ}り{向|む}く: to turn around (only physical, not reflective)
- {顧|かえり}みる: to reflect on, consider (more literary)
- {回顧|かいこ}する: to look back on (formal, written)
